content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service); the retro-auth window is closed, no peer-to-peer is offered, and an appeal has already been filed with no further payer avenue. CO-197 is a provider-liability denial for failing to obtain required authorization, so the balance cannot be billed to the patient. With no viable path to payer recovery remaining, the correct action is to close the balance as uncollectible.","action":"write_off"}
